why: Every entry is a reader that obtains a VALUE by parsing another language's SOURCE. This is recorded debt, not an exemption: an entry whose site is gone or whose pattern changed is `value_read_baseline_stale` and must be deleted, and the fix each entry names is its own unit.

sites.owed: the frontend test lifts the discovery-mutation union's member names out of the Host's schema source; the browser contract should publish those members as data, the way `model-field-budget.published.json` does
the presentation test lifts the code vocabulary out of the surface it tests; the presentation codes should be published as data the test reads
the Host test lifts the Mod's lifecycle-to-filename mapping out of C# source; the generated action surface JSON is the artifact to read
the same test then parses the registration list out of the same C# file; the same generated action surface closes both
the Host test parses the Mod's registration list out of C# source; the generated action surface JSON is the artifact to read
the Mod's occupant vocabulary is parsed out of its C# constants; the constants need a published artifact beside them, the shape `host/src/model-field-budget.published.json` already uses
the Host's wire rows are read for the charge ladder's bounds; the table needs a published bounds artifact instead of a regex over `integerRow`

sites.pattern: function isReasonCode\(value: unknown\): value is string \{\s*return typeof value === \"string\" && /([^/]+)/
sites.owed: the Host's reason-code alphabet is lifted out of the validator's own source; the alphabet should be published as data the Mod and the Host both read
the Host's footprint ladder is parsed out of the packing table; the ladder needs a published artifact the engine parity test reads
the Host's field-array ceiling is taken out of the validator's body; the ceiling belongs in a published bound, not in a regex over the function that enforces it
a test reads another gate's report keys out of its source; the discovery-channels gate's JSON report is the artifact to read instead
the Host's snapshot family rows are parsed out of its source; `SNAPSHOT_FAMILY_RULES` needs a published table
the same footprint ladder as EngineParityRegistry.cs, read by a second test; one published artifact closes both
the gate reads the Mod's bridge model properties out of C# source; the bridge frame table already has a generated JSON authority to read instead
the gate reads the Host's published action list out of the loop that registers each tool; the action surface it audits should be read as the artifact the Host publishes
the gate reads the wire kind set out of TypeScript; the protocol's kind table needs a published member list, the same gap the other protocol reads in this file record
the gate takes a route id literal out of the identity module; the route table it protects should be published for the gate to read
the gate takes a route id out of the browser contract's literal; the route table it protects should be published for the gate to read
the gate parses the C# switch for the operations a session dispatches; the Mod's generated action surface is the artifact to read
the same import walk over the route module; the same published surface table closes both
the gate walks a frontend component's relatives by parsing its import statements; a published route/surface table is the artifact this needs

the capture test reads the vendored plugin's block name out of its TypeScript; the observation the capture kit records should name it instead
the test reads the Mod's config property names by matching C# property syntax; the fixture contract should be published beside the config it describes
the test parses the Mod's declared action ids out of its C# registration calls; the same generated action surface closes this and the Host-side reads above
